answer: The handbook states 16 paid vacation days per year for each of the first five years of work for the employer. It also states that for the second and third days of illness the employer pays 50% of regular salary.
informationLabel: This summary is provided for general informational purposes only, and is not a substitute for the wording of the relevant laws, regulations, procedures and extension orders, which are binding.

claims.quote: For each of the first five years of work for the employer: 16 paid vacation days per year.
For the second and third days of illness, the employer must pay the employee 50% of his regular salary
